$schema_note: Wireframe spec for generating Court of Beasts backdrop artwork at this aspect ratio. All zones measured from the live UI. px coordinates apply at canvas_px; pct values (fraction of width/height) let you rescale to any same-ratio canvas. The artwork sits BEHIND the UI - zones marked ui_occlusion are covered by interface elements.
style: Painterly torch-lit dungeon vault: smooth ashlar stone wall, fine cracks, near-black exposure.
No creatures, characters, banners or text - the UI supplies all focal content; the art is atmosphere only.
Keep contrast LOW inside every ui_occlusion_zone; save texture interest for the space between zones.
A subtle gold hairline frame with sapphire diamond finials (top/bottom center) and emerald corner fittings echoes the title plaque.
Strong vignette toward edges; slightly darkened 'stage' behind the board zone so the gold grid pops.

palette.reference: docs/title-art-style.json (same gold/stone/gem palette as the title plaque)

title.note: Title plaque image overlays here (transparent PNG).

board.note: 3x3 gold grid - keep this area darkest and least detailed.

flame_left.note: Animated warm flame (DOM element) - paint a soft orange light pool on the wall behind it.

flame_right.note: Animated cool blue flame (DOM element) - paint a soft sapphire light pool behind it.

gold_hairline_frame.note: Slim double gold rule tracing the canvas edge at this inset; keep alpha subtle (~50%).

gem_finials.emerald_corners: small emerald fittings at all four frame corners

stage_darkening.note: Soft elliptical darkening centered on the board zone (~15% darker).

art_features.faction_washes: Faction washes: faint RED tint across the TOP third (opponent), faint BLUE across the BOTTOM third (player).
art_features.vignette: Darken smoothly toward all edges; corners near-black.

delivery.format: JPG or PNG, opaque, no transparency needed
delivery.cropping_warning: The game displays the art with cover-fit, so on odd window sizes the outermost ~5% may crop; keep nothing essential in the outer margin except the frame (which may crop gracefully).
